name: Rashid Lasker
bio: Hey there, I'm Rashid, a builder with an interest in interfaces, complex frontend systems, and user interactions.

I'm currently at xAI building [grok.com](https://grok.com/). In the past, I built complex labeling systems at Scale AI and worked on 3D high-definition maps at Uber. I also developed a system design course at a nonprofit called HackCville while studying at the University of Virginia.
